focus: GitHub Actions dependency confusion via compromised third-party workflow steps (CVE-2025-30066)
signal_source: cloud_cluster: 'GitHub Actions Dependency Confusion Attack via Compromised Workflow Steps' (reach_score=87, conf=87)

hypotheses.behavior: T1195.001 - Supply Chain Compromise: Compromise Software Dependencies (malicious GitHub Actions step executing during CI)
hypotheses.evidence_field: index=cicd sourcetype=github_actions workflow_conclusion=failure OR process_name=node CommandLine=*actions-cdn*
hypotheses.data_gap: No GitHub Actions runner logs ingested into Splunk. The CI/CD team uses GitHub-hosted runners — stdout/stderr from workflow steps is not forwarded to any SIEM. Cannot determine if actions-cdn[.]io was contacted during any workflow run.
hypotheses.recommended_fix: Enable GitHub audit log streaming to Splunk via the GitHub Enterprise audit log streaming API. At minimum, ingest workflow_run webhook events to capture conclusion, triggering actor, and head_sha.

hypotheses.behavior: T1041 - Exfiltration Over C2 Channel (post-compromise exfil from CI runner to actions-cdn[.]io)
hypotheses.evidence_field: index=network sourcetype=palo:traffic dest=*actions-cdn* OR dest_ip IN (lookup for actions-cdn.io resolution)
hypotheses.data_gap: GitHub-hosted runners egress from GitHub's IP ranges (140.82.0.0/16, 192.30.0.0/18), not from corporate network — these connections are invisible to the corporate proxy and firewall. Self-hosted runners on 10.0.5.0/24 do transit corporate egress — no connections to actions-cdn[.]io found from that subnet in 30-day window, but GitHub-hosted runner traffic is unobservable.
hypotheses.recommended_fix: Migrate high-sensitivity pipelines (secret-touching, production deploy) to self-hosted runners so their egress transits corporate network monitoring.

hypotheses.behavior: T1552.001 - Unsecured Credentials: Credentials In Files (secrets exposed in workflow logs or artifacts)
hypotheses.data_gap: Same as H1 — GitHub audit log not streaming to Splunk.

key_fp_notes: No FP notes — hunt was inconclusive due to telemetry gaps, not data reviewed.
re_hunt_trigger: Re-run immediately after GitHub audit log streaming is enabled. Also re-run if self-hosted runner logs begin appearing in index=cicd.
escalation_actions_taken: Filed platform-eng ticket PE-1193: Enable GitHub Enterprise audit log streaming to Splunk HEC
Filed platform-eng ticket PE-1194: Evaluate migration of deploy workflows to self-hosted runners
Manually reviewed .github/workflows/ in top-5 repos for references to actions-cdn[.]io — none found; does not rule out transitive dependency use
